elevation.$description: Elevation in fixed steps. Every surface stands on one of them, and a step is a shadow and a stacking order together, so something that floats over a card also paints over it. The ground and a well are flat. Raised is a card and what sticks to one; float is what opens over a card, such as a menu, a list or a bubble, and what the pointer holds; modal is a window or a sheet over the scrim. The raised shadow is the light engine's, above; the higher steps add a longer, softer one beneath it, and are declared wherever a theme is set, so they build on that theme's raised shadow.
The one shadow every app already reads, the raised step.

elevation-notch.$description: A heading notch lies flat on its card: a short contact shadow and no lift of its own, since the card carries it.
